あらすじ

How far would you be willing to go for love? Adam and Simon have been friends for a long time, with a quiet, unrequited love that seems to go nowhere. Determined to confront his fears, Simon is ready to meet Adam, but discovers that his close friend has a dark secret.

A tale of love, food, and murder.
